title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Driven Platforms)

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong experience designing, building, and scaling modern web applications and SaaS platforms. In this role, you will work across the entire stack, from intuitive frontend interfaces to robust backend services, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered solutions. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver high-impact, scalable systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and scale full-stack web applications and SaaS platforms
  • Build high-quality, maintainable frontend experiences using modern frameworks
  • Develop APIs and backend services with a focus on performance, security, and scalability
  • Architect and manage cloud-native infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
  • Implement AI-powered features using foundation models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures
  • Ensure reliability through automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and observability best practices
  • Collaborate in English on a daily basis with cross-functional and international teams

Technical Requirements

Frontend

  • Strong experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.Js
  • Proficiency with modern CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS

Backend

  • Solid experience with Node.Js (Express and/or NestJS) and/or Python (FastAPI or Django)

Databases

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or AWS Aurora
  • Experience with Vector Data Stores (Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, or Pinecone)

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Deep familiarity with AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, API Gateway) or GCP
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK)

AI & Orchestration

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock (working with foundation models like Claude or Llama)
  • Experience with Google Vertex AI
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and RAG architectures

DevOps & CI/CD

  • Experience with Docker and GitLab CI
  • Strong knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, AWS CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, and Google Cloud Logging

Testing

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, PyTest, Playwright, or Cypress

Developer Tools

  • Advanced proficiency with AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitLab Duo, and Claude Code

Language Requirements

  • Advanced English proficiency for daily communication

Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy ("Who's investing in my peers?") to daily workflow ("What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?") into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market;
proactive outreach tools;
share & peer holder tracking;
customisable reports;
and professional-level support.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.

You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You'll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.

You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.Com.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.

description:
Role Overview: As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our "agentic" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. - Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.G., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.Com) or code-based frameworks (e.G., LangGraph, CrewAI).

- Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.

Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

- Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.

Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

- Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.

Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.

Must Have

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

- Availability to travel.

- Legally authorized to work in Brazil.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

- A collaborative and international work environment.

- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.

Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere.

Description

We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.

Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.
  • Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.).
  • Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors.
  • Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows.
  • Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components.
  • Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.

Profile Requirements

  • Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders.
  • Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments.
  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better.
  • Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency inPortuguese and English. Must meetfit and properstandards withno disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Gerente De Aterro Sanitário | Biogás
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1o de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar a operação de biogás e biometano, desde o campo de gás até a entrega do produto para o parceiro terceirizado.

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.

Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.

You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.

While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.

title: Cx Ai & Knowledge Manager (Remote/Brazil)
description:
About us

Carepod is a growing e-commerce brand focused on delivering a great customer experience at every step. We believe support should be fast, accurate, human, and scalable. We use AI to help our team work smarter, but we still care deeply about quality, clarity, and trust.

About the role

We are hiring a CX AI & Knowledge Manager to own the systems behind great support.

This person will manage our customer-facing knowledge, train and improve Gorgias AI, review and QA AI responses, keep our FAQ and help center up to date, and help train our team on the right processes and information.

You will be the person making sure our customers get accurate answers, our AI gets smarter over time, and our support team has the tools and guidance they need to do great work.

What you'll own
  • Own and maintain the source of truth for support knowledge, product information, policies, and FAQs
  • Train, test, and improve Gorgias AI so responses are accurate, helpful, and on-brand
  • Review AI-generated customer responses and build a QA process to catch issues early
  • Update help center articles, FAQs, macros, and internal SOPs as products and policies change
  • Work with CX, product, operations, and marketing teams to keep information consistent across channels
  • Help onboard and train support team members on tools, workflows, and knowledge resources
  • Identify repeated support issues and fix the root cause through better documentation, automation, or training
  • Track key metrics tied to AI quality, knowledge coverage, support accuracy, and team enablement
What success looks like in the first 90 days
  • Audit our current help center, macros, and Gorgias AI setup
  • Clean up the biggest knowledge gaps affecting customers and support agents
  • Improve AI response quality for our most common support questions
  • Launch a simple QA process for AI responses
  • Create a repeatable system for updating customer-facing and internal knowledge when the business changes
  • Make it easier for team members to find the right answer fast
What we're looking for
  • 3+ years in customer experience, CX operations, knowledge management, support enablement, or a similar role
  • Hands-on experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, Intercom, or another support platform
  • Strong writing and editing skills
  • Experience building or maintaining a help center, FAQ library, or internal knowledge base
  • Comfortable reviewing support conversations and turning patterns into process improvements
  • Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to turn messy information into clear guidance
  • Able to train people, not just tools
Bonus points
  • Experience in e-commerce, especially Shopify brands
  • Experience with AI support tools, automation, and QA workflows
  • Experience writing SOPs, training materials, or internal playbooks
  • Familiarity with product catalogs, product information, or merchandising workflows
Why this role matters

This role sits at the center of customer truth. When done well, it improves customer trust, reduces mistakes, helps the support team move faster, and makes AI genuinely useful.

How to apply

Please apply with your resume and a short note answering these 3 questions:

  • Tell us about a knowledge base, FAQ, or support system you improved.
  • Tell us about a time you trained or improved an AI or automation workflow.
  • How would you keep product information accurate across multiple teams?

Sobre a posição

Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Full-Stack Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos que combinam infraestrutura crítica com Inteligência Artificial, em um ambiente onde segurança, escala e performance não são negociáveis.

  • Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento full-stack: desde interfaces até backend, integrações com modelos de IA e monitoramento em produção;
  • Definir arquitetura e fluxos de usuário utilizando ferramentas e agentes de IA como apoio à geração, testes e evolução de código;
  • Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis para uso intensivo de LLMs, com foco em performance, disponibilidade e experiência do usuário
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD e MLOps para entrega contínua e segura de aplicações e modelos;
  • Garantir qualidade técnica por meio de revisões de código e aderência a boas práticas de engenharia e segurança da informação;
  • Ser referência técnica no time, contribuindo para a disseminação do desenvolvimento assistido por IA.
Competências técnicas
  • Sólida base em engenharia de software: algoritmos, design de sistemas e arquitetura full-stack independente de linguagem;
  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com uso de ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou Replit;
  • Domínio de ecossistemas de IA: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, LangChain ou Llama Index;
  • Experiência comAPIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos com containers (Docker) e orquestração;
  • Conhecimento embancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Capacidade de implementar testes automatizados ao longo do ciclo de vida do software;
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.
Conhecimentos desejáveis

  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento emética de IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e mitigação de vieses em modelos.

Há mais de 20 anos, a UPX protege ambientes digitais que não podem falhar. Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.

Nosso portfólio integra soluções em Serviços de Segurança Gerenciada AI-driven, Proteção de Borda, Proteção de Endpoints e Segurança de Agentes de IA.

Aqui você vai trabalhar com especialistas que operam em ambientes onde o erro tem consequências reais, onde problemas são complexos e o trabalho importa. Se você gosta de pensar no todo, não só na sua parte, você pensa como nós.

description: Exciting New Career Opportunity:Software Engineer - Quality & AI Infrastructure Company:Hirebus Location:Remote in Brazil Pay:$30K-$60K per yearWe're hiring a mid-level engineer to own two things: the quality of our codebase and the early foundations of our AI agent work.The role Most of your time will be spent making our existing software more reliable. You'll dig into production bugs, trace them to root cause, and write the tests that should have caught them. You'll review pull requests in a way that raises the bar without demoralizing anyone. You'll tackle the tech debt that everyone complains about in retros but nobody picks up.The other part — and this is growing — is our AI agent work. We're building tooling, orchestration, and evaluation systems for LLM-powered features. This isn't a research project. It's production software that needs the same rigor as everything else we ship. We need someone who can bring that rigor.What you'll do Debug and fix issues across the stack, from staging through production Build meaningful test coverage (the kind that actually catches regressions) Review code thoroughly — with context, not just style nits Refactor the parts of the codebase that slow the team down Help define how we ship: observability, release process, quality gates Work with product and design to land features cleanly Contribute to our AI agent infrastructure: tool-calling, orchestration, evaluation, safetyTechnical Requirements 7+ years of professional engineering experience with a track record of shipping production SaaS products Expert in Node.Js, React, and TypeScript with strong product architecture instincts (scalability, maintainability, speed of iteration) Hands-on Supabase experience: Postgres schema design, RLS policies, edge functions, and auth Shipped production LLM-powered features (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) with a working understanding of prompt engineering, evals, latency/cost tradeoffs, and guardrails Experience building agentic workflows, RAG systems, or tool-use integrations (MCP, function calling) Excellent written English and self-directed async work style, with meaningful overlap with US Mountain Time Comfortable using AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflowYour first 90 days: Month 1: You've shipped real bug fixes. You're in the PR review rotation and contributing useful feedback. You have context on the parts of the system that break most often. Month 2: Test coverage in your area has improved measurably. You've identified at least one chunk of tech debt worth prioritizing and started on it. Month 3: You've shipped a meaningful refactor. You've made your first contributions to the AI agent infrastructure — something concrete, with results we can point to.We're not looking for someone who wants to rewrite everything from scratch. We want someone who makes the team steadily better — through reliable fixes, honest reviews, and the kind of infrastructure work that compounds over time. title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

Actively participate in professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge of cloud technologies.What We're Looking For:Bachelor's or Technology degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field. At least three years working in an AWS, Azure or Google Cloud environment. At least one professional-level cloud certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer. Strong understanding of core cloud provider services, including compute, networking, storage, database, and security. Understanding of AWS, and Azure framework principles and practices. Understanding of FinOps principles and cloud cost optimization best practices. Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts and familiarity with AI tools and services. Experience with ticketing systems and customer support workflows. Basic knowledge of networking principles and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP). Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Fluency in English, both written and verbal. Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools. Strong written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.Bonus Points For:Certifications in more than one cloud provider FinOps Certified Practitioner or experience with cloud cost management tools. Experience with cloud provider AI/ML services. Experience conducting Well-Architected best-practice reviews. Knowledge of DevOps principles and practices. Experience in a technology consulting environment. Experience with multiple cloud platforms.What We Offer:Collaborative and inclusive work culture with opportunities for growth and advancement. Exciting projects with leading-edge cloud technologies. title: Lead Generation Specialist
description: The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.About Us Publicity For Good(PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects. Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns. Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns. Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage. Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized. Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence. Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows. Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions. Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations. Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings. Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources. Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries. Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates. Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates. Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.Results Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets. Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads). Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status. Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context. Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns. Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation. Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality. Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.Requirements Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years. Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively. Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools. Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems. Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities. Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills. Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision. Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns. Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred. Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems. Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs. Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information. Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

A Indrel Scientific é líder no desenvolvimento e produção de refrigeradores e freezers científicos destinados às áreas médica, laboratorial e de pesquisas. Com mais de 30 produtos em sua linha, oferecemos equipamentos de baixa e ultra baixa temperatura, atingindo até -86°C, utilizando as tecnologias mais avançadas do mercado. Contamos com um centro de pesquisa dedicado ao desenvolvimento de soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade, sempre alinhadas às demandas do mercado. Nosso propósito é levar a tecnologia brasileira ao mais alto nível no mercado global.Descrição do Cargo: Estamos contratando um Técnico em Refrigeração para atuar em várias localidades do Brasil. As principais responsabilidades incluem realizar manutenção preventiva, corretiva e reparos de equipamentos de refrigeração científica, diagnóstico de falhas técnicas e instalações de sistemas de climatização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral que exige disponibilidade para trabalho presencial e viagens frequentes.Descrição de atividades: Realizar serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva no sistema mecânico e elétrico e estrutural no equipamento de refrigeração Realizar instalação, montagem e testes em equipamento de refrigeração;
Realizar testes nos sistemas de refrigeração de acordo com treinamento prévio fornecido pela empresa;
Exercer controle de qualidade em equipamentos instalados em clientes;
Elaborar o relatório deserviços executados em acordo com o padrão estabelecido. Manter contato com as operações para tomar conhecimento dos problemas operacionais, assuntos relevantes e recomendar pequenas alterações de sistemas, upgrades e ou algum reparo necessário nos equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade. Realizar mapeamento de clientes e manter contato com área de contratos para detecção de futuras oportunidades de negócio;
Qualificações: Manutenção Preventiva e Solução de Problemas: Experiência na realização de manutenções preventivas e diagnósticos rápidos para identificação e resolução de falhas técnicas. Eletricidade e Reparo: Conhecimento em sistemas elétricos e habilidades para realizar reparos em equipamentos de refrigeração. Desejável formação técnica em refrigeração, elétrica ou áreas correlatas, além de possuir certificações na área como diferencial.Pré-requisitos: Curso técnico ou Ensino Médio profissionalizante completo em Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecânica ou similares Conhecimento em refrigeração, ar-condicionado e climatização Conhecimento avançado dos produtos comercializados pela área de refrigeração Conhecimento do Pacote Office (Power Point, Excel);
Habilidade de comunicação, análise e solução de problemas. Disponibilidade para viagensResponsabilidades: · Pelo serviço executado;
· Pelo material de consumo, equipamentos e material permanente a sua disposição, fornecidos pela empresa.Habilidades: Habilidade em comunicação: o profissional precisa ter uma boa comunicação para interagir com outros colaboradores, fornecedores e clientes, seja pessoalmente, por telefone ou e-mail. Organização: ser organizado é essencial para executar tarefas de forma eficiente e mantê-las em ordem. Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe: o cargo geralmente envolve dinâmicas em conjunto, portanto, é fundamental ter habilidades para trabalhar em grupo e cooperar com outras pessoas. Disposição para aprender: como a atuação em diferentes áreas e setores, é importante estar sempre atualizado e disposto a aprender coisas novas. Capacidade de lidar com diversas tarefas simultâneas e alta demanda;
Agilidade: para resolução de conflitos e manutenção agenda e retorno aos clientes.Desejável: · Disponibilidade para início imediato;

title: Cientista De Dados Pl
description:
Cientista de Dados - Machine LearningEstamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados talentoso e inovador para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve ter sólida experiência em Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning, com habilidades em classificação, Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), técnicas estatísticas e validação de modelos. Esperamos que você tenha um forte entendimento de feature engineering e métricas de desempenho.Responsabilidades:- Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Modelos: Construir, treinar e validar modelos de machine learning, aplicando técnicas avançadas de classificação e NLP para resolver problemas complexos de negócios.

title: Formação De Assessores De Investimentos
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Assessor(a) de Investimentos para atuar de forma estratégica na construção e no fortalecimento do relacionamento com clientes, oferecendo soluções financeiras personalizadas e alinhadas aos objetivos de curto, médio e longo prazo.

Esta posição contempla uma jornada estruturada de formação, na qual o profissional desenvolve competências técnicas e comerciais até assumir a gestão de carteira e evoluir na carreira de assessoria dentro da EQI.

Jornada de Formação – Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI

A jornada é estruturada para acelerar o desenvolvimento técnico, comercial e estratégico do profissional, que desde o primeiro dia já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI.

  • 1º mês | Onboarding
  • Período de imersão completa na estrutura da EQI, com foco em capacitação técnica e comercial. O assessor aprofunda conhecimentos sobre mercado financeiro, produtos, processos internos, ferramentas e cultura organizacional, além de desenvolver habilidades de vendas e abordagem consultiva.
  • 2º mês | Prospecção
  • Início da atuação comercial supervisionada, com foco na geração de oportunidades. O profissional realiza prospecção ativa, qualificação de leads, participa de reuniões e estrutura seu pipeline, evoluindo na condução de conversas estratégicas com investidores.
  • 3º e 4º meses | Aquisição
  • Fase de maior autonomia na condução do ciclo comercial. O assessor passa a realizar reuniões, captar recursos e estruturar as primeiras carteiras, desenvolvendo capacidade de negociação, relacionamento e fechamento de negócios.
  • Meses seguintes | Alocação e Consolidação
  • Momento de fortalecimento e expansão da carteira, com definição de estratégias de investimento, adequação de produtos ao perfil do cliente e aprofundamento do relacionamento de longo prazo.
  • Ao longo de toda a jornada, o profissional conta com simulações comerciais com apoio de IA, suporte técnico especializado e fornecimento de leads para impulsionar o crescimento.
  • Evolução
  • Após a conclusão da formação, permanece como Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI, agora com maior domínio técnico, autonomia ampliada e atuação mais estratégica com plano de carreira estruturado com 12 Níveis de desenvolvimento.

O que importa no nosso processo seletivo?

- Fit Cultural;

- Certificação CPA-20 (CPA +CPROR), CEA (CPROI) ou CFP;

- Conhecimento sobre Investimentos (RV, RF, Fundos, entre outros);

- Perfil comercial e relacional;

- Disponibilidadeem tempo integral (100% presencial);

- Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação profissional no Mercado Financeiro (Banco, Corretora, AAI ou Family Office).

Por que escolher a EQI?

title: Customer Retention Specialist
description: About us: Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market.We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Retention Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.What You'll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.What We're Looking For: 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role. 3+ years within a SaaS company. Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet. Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts. Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure. Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies. Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality. Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value. Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player. Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday. Bonus Points: Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company. Experience working with real estate professionals.️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer success experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? description: ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO 100% remoto Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimentoSOBRE A ADAFLOW A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.Conheça mais em:  agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara.DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!Inscreva-se pelo formulário:

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Business Development Representative

open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training. title: Senior Video Editor
description: Company Description ONDA Creative Studio is a format development and production studio based in London, producing content for creators and brands across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and beyond. We're hiring a senior video editor to join the team on a part-time retainer basis.The Role You'll be the lead editor across multiple creator and brand projects. The primary focus is a recurring live dating show format filmed in front of a live audience — approximately 90 minutes, filmed with 4 cameras, edited into a 45-60 minute hero video plus 4-5 short-form cutdowns. Beyond this, you'll edit long-form YouTube content, short-form brand and creator videos, fitness content, social-first reels, and campaign pieces for clients across a range of industries and platforms.What You'll Do Edit long-form content (45-60 min) from unscripted, multi-camera live footage. Build narrative, manage pacing, create hooks Cut short-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and LinkedIn — platform-native edits with hooks, captions, and pacing Sync and assemble multicam footage (4 camera angles) from live events Sound design and colour grade to a broadcast-ready standard Edit across a variety of content types: creator, brand partnership, fitness, talking head, social-first, and event content Work within DaVinci Resolve shared project environments where possible, so timelines are accessible to the wider team Use AI tools (specifically Higgsfield) for short-form content workflows where appropriateWhat We're Looking For Strong long-form editing skills (15+ min). You understand pacing, retention, hooks, and storytelling from raw unscripted material. Show us your best work Strong short-form editing instinct. You know what makes someone stop scrolling. Platform-native editing for vertical and horizontal formats DaVinci Resolve proficiency is strongly preferred. Shared project experience is a major plus. Not a dealbreaker, but a significant advantage Multicam editing experience is a bonus, ideally from live events, reality TV, or unscripted formats Competent sound design and colour grading. Your grades should be clean and your audio broadcast-ready Self-directed. You can take a rough brief and deliver a polished first cut without needing frame-by-frame instructions Reliable. You deliver when you say you will. If something changes, you communicate before the deadline, not after Open to AI-assisted workflows. Specifically Higgsfield for short-form content. You don't need to be an expert, but you need to be curious Politically impartial and professional. ONDA works with clients across a range of industries, causes, and viewpoints. This role requires a professional, unbiased approach to all content — the work is the work, regardless of subject matterDetails HOURS: Part-time (roughly 30 hours per week) RATE: Competitive monthly retainer, based on experience and portfolio strength LOCATION: Fully remote. Any timezone. Deadlines are the measure, not hours SOFTWARE: DaVinci Resolve strongly preferred DURATION: Ongoing, with a 4-week paid trial period START: May 2026

title: Ai Automation Specialist
description:
Hey, Dingus!

Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, systems-minded AI Automation Specialist who can build, connect, and scale intelligent workflows that actually work in production.

About Us

Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.

Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain automated workflows using N8N, connecting APIs, webhooks, and data sources into seamless pipelines.
  • Integrate and prompt Claude (Anthropic) and other LLMs into production systems, not just experiments.
  • Manage and automate data operations in Airtable, including scripted fields, automations, and structured data pipelines.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort across client delivery, internal ops, and content production.
  • Troubleshoot broken pipelines, handle edge cases, and document systems so they don't live only in your head.
  • Collaborate with strategy and delivery teams to identify automation opportunities and scope builds accurately.
  • Stay current on the AI tooling landscape, you should know what's worth using before we ask.
  • Own and iterate on AI agent logic and system prompts, understanding why a workflow behaves the way it does and improving it over time.
  • Build net-new internal AI tools as the business identifies opportunities, not just maintain what exists.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building automated workflows (N8N, Make.Com, or Zapier, N8N strongly preferred).
  • Real experience integrating LLMs via API (Claude, GPT, or equivalent) into production pipelines with structured outputs.
  • Proficiency in Airtable as a data layer, scripting, automations, relational structures.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and webhook-based integrations.
  • Basic scripting ability in Python or JavaScript, enough to write and debug function nodes without hand-holding.
  • A working understanding of HTML and CSS is imperative, you need to be able to read, interpret, and make sense of front-end structure when workflows touch web-based outputs.
  • A systems thinker mindset: you design the whole loop, not just the happy path.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Comfort with versioning and testing AI outputs, you notice when a prompt change breaks something and know how to fix it.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with vector databases or basic RAG pipelines (Pinecone, Supabase, etc.).
  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks (LangChain, or equivalent concepts).
  • Experience in a digital agency or client-services environment.
  • Exposure to prompt engineering best practices, like system prompts, chaining, few-shot design.

Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English

If you're someone who can look at a messy manual process, see the system hiding inside it, and build something that runs without you, we want to hear from you.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description: Senior Fullstack Developer — bTd Travel & JetsBTD Business Traveler Deals Brazil Ltda · 100% Remote Contractor · Full-TimeApril 2026Who We Are bTd Travel & Jets is a high-luxury corporate concierge platform that redefines how enterprises manage premium travel. We unify private jet bookings, helicopter transfers, and first-class commercial flights into a single, seamless experience — and we're building the AI layer that makes it all feel effortless. Our mission is simple: let travelers focus on their business (or their vacation) while we handle every detail with precision and elegance. We serve enterprise clients who expect nothing less than perfection, and our technology needs to match that standard.The Role We're looking for aSenior Fullstack Developerwho thrives at the intersection of robust platform engineering and cutting-edge AI. You'll own end-to-end features — from a polished React UI to a Supabase edge function to a live AI agent pipeline — and you'll play a central role in buildingbTd Bella, our AI concierge agent powered by AWS Bedrock. This is ahands-on engineering role. You will build, ship, and iterate in production — not just advise. If you've deployed AI agents that real users depend on and you love owning hard problems from architecture to release, we want to hear from you.What You'll DoMigrate production infrastructure— move our environment from Replit to a dedicated, secure, and scalable VPS, building the foundation for the next phase of growth. Architect and ship bTd Bella— own the full lifecycle of our AWS Bedrock managed agent: setup, tool integration, knowledge base, guardrails, prompt tuning, and observability. Build AI-powered platform features— intelligent travel search, natural language booking flows, automated approval workflows, and proactive traveler notifications. Expand travel and payment integrations— POS providers, GDS/NDC APIs, Stripe, and Expedia Pay. Raise the bar on code quality and architecture— consolidate the codebase, enforce security standards, and mentor the team on AI and fullstack best practices.✦ bTd Bella — AI Concierge Agent · AWS Bedrock Bella is the heart of our AI strategy. She is a fully managed, multi-step conversational agent that assists corporate travelers with everything — finding flights, booking private jets, managing itineraries, routing approvals, and sending proactive alerts — all within a secure, policy-aware enterprise environment. Your mission with Bella:configure, deploy, and continuously improve a production-grade managed agent on AWS Bedrock. You'll define her tools, shape her reasoning, connect her to live data sources, and keep her accurate, safe, and cost-efficient at scale.What you'll build for BellaManaged Agent Setup— Configure and deploy Bella as a fully managed agent on AWS Bedrock Agents: define action groups, instruction sets, session memory, and tool-calling behavior from end to end. Tool & API Integration— Connect Bella to flight search APIs, booking systems, approval workflows, and billing via Lambda-backed action groups with clean OpenAPI schemas. Knowledge & RAG Pipeline— Build and maintain the retrieval pipeline powering Bella's knowledge: travel policies, vendor catalogs, and traveler preferences via Bedrock Knowledge Bases. Guardrails & Safety— Implement Bedrock Guardrails to keep Bella on-topic, PII-safe, and hallucination-resistant in every interaction. Prompt Engineering— Write and iterate on Bella's system prompts, persona, and reasoning instructions so her responses feel accurate, human, and on-brand for luxury travel. Evaluation & Reliability— Build evaluation pipelines to track tool-selection accuracy, response quality, and latency — and act on the results continuously.Tech StackFrontend:React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui Backend:Deno/TypeScript Edge Functions via Supabase Database:PostgreSQL with RLS, pgvector Infrastructure:Linux VPS, NGINX, Docker, SSL/Let's Encrypt CI/CD:GitHub Actions Payments:Stripe, Expedia Pay AI & Agents:AWS Bedrock (Claude 3, Amazon Nova, Titan Embeddings), Bedrock Agents, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, LangChainWhat We're Looking ForFullstack Engineering5+ years building production applications with TypeScript across the full stack (React + Node.Js/Deno). Deep React 18 expertise: TanStack Query, react-hook-form, TailwindCSS, and scalable component architecture. Solid Supabase experience — Auth, Edge Functions, RLS policies, and safe migrations. Advanced PostgreSQL: complex queries, indexing strategies, transactions, and window functions. DevOps fluency: Linux VPS administration, NGINX, Docker, systemd, and CI/CD via GitHub Actions. Payment integration experience, preferably Stripe — idempotency, webhook verification, and signature handling. Third-party API integrations including POS systems, GDS/NDC travel platforms, and async webhook handling with retry logic. Security-first mindset: least privilege, secret management, and OWASP Top 10 compliance. AI, Agents — Hands-On RequiredWe need real, production experience — not theory. If you've set up a managed agent on AWS Bedrock, connected it to live tools, and made it work reliably under load, that's exactly what we're hiring for.Hands-on experience setting up fully managed agents on AWS Bedrock Agents or similar— action group definition, instruction tuning, session memory configuration, and multi-step tool-calling orchestration. Experience building Lambda-backed action groups with OpenAPI schema authoring, error handling, and idempotency. Practical knowledge of Bedrock Knowledge Bases: S3 data ingestion, chunking strategies, Titan Embeddings, and semantic retrieval tuning. Strong prompt engineering skills: system prompt design, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought reasoning, structured output enforcement, and persona calibration. Experience with Amazon Bedrock Guardrails: content filtering, PII redaction, topic denial policies, and grounding checks. Ability to design and implement human-in-the-loop (HITL) flows — approval steps, escalation paths, and agent override mechanisms. AWS IAM design for Bedrock workloads: service roles, Lambda execution roles, and least-privilege cross-service access patterns. LLM cost management: token budget strategies, model tier selection, caching, and per-tenant consumption monitoring. AI observability experience: tracing agent steps, logging LLM inputs/outputs, and evaluating response quality with CloudWatch, LangSmith, or equivalent. DifferentiatorsExperience in the travel industry — GDS, NDC, Amadeus, Sabre, or Expedia. AWS certification (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML Specialty). Familiarity with multi-agent patterns: supervisor/worker agents, parallel tool execution, and EventBridge-triggered workflows. AWS Step Functions for orchestrating long-running agentic workflows with human approval gates. Background in multi-tenant SaaS architecture. Comfortable with AI productivity tools — Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor. Technical English for communication with international partners. What We Offer100% remotewith flexible hours — work where and when you do your best work. Real autonomy— your architectural decisions ship and your engineering impact is visible every day. A technically ambitious project at the intersection of luxury travel and cutting-edge AI. Modern, well-defined stack with no legacy baggage — we move fast and build things right. Full-time contract withcompetitive compensationmatched to your seniority level.
